sample.remaining_policy: the reference action frozen before the bank, with the same common guard
sample.selected_prefix: the prescheduled trajectory-0 action at decision-0, independently executed for 48 steps

scope.all_rows: complete inventory and SHA256, source/panel identities, terminal value arithmetic, recorded clone/prefix/optimizer continuity, decision chronology, exact gradient and observation counters
scope.sampled_execution: four full terminal-reference branches plus one selected prefix; no other execution sample selected after outcomes
scope.fitting: all retained whole-trajectory CV and full-fit coefficients, normalizers, projection matrices, alpha choices and candidate counts checked independently when available

access_rule: Do not load actual V3 roles until all three banks are complete and root supplies the matching authorized bank freeze
